title: Lithuania converts a Bolide/RBS-70 contract into reported air-defence delivery before firing readiness or protection is visible
source_unit: Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence account of Bolide missile delivery for the RBS-70 system
geography: Lithuania; Lithuanian Air Defence Battalion and RBS-70 short-range air-defence system

receipt_stage.value: Lithuania received a delivery of Bolide missiles for the RBS-70 man-portable short-range anti-aircraft system

delivery_value.unit: euros; reported value of the delivered equipment

system_and_user.value: RBS-70 system used by the Lithuanian Air Defence Battalion

technical_description.value: laser-guided Bolide missile described as effective up to 9 km and resistant to electronic jamming

supply_contract.unit: euros; over this amount reported for a 2025 contract intended to ensure supply during 2026–2032

readiness_and_effect.unit: missing quantity, acceptance, allocation, crew training, maintenance, firing readiness, operational use, future replenishment, interception, civilian protection, deterrence, and public judgment

mechanism.value: A delivered missile replenishes a named short-range air-defence system and creates a supply-continuity pathway, but delivery and technical specifications are not firing readiness or demonstrated protection.

observations.method: Structured extraction from the Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence delivery announcement. Receipt, value, manufacturer, system link, technical description, future contract, and unmeasured readiness and effects are coded as separate stages.
observations.uncertainty: The announcement does not disclose missile quantity, lot, acceptance records, allocation, crew training, maintenance, firing readiness, future delivery performance, operational use, interception, or strategic effect.
observations.subgroup: Lithuanian Air Defence Battalion and crews, Saab Dynamics and defense suppliers, allied air-defence institutions, and civilians potentially covered by the system; no affected-person denominator is supplied.
observations.counterinterpretation: The delivery may improve stockpile continuity and future air-defence capacity, while stored equipment can remain unused or generate fiscal, maintenance, escalation, and civilian-risk costs not measured by the official account.

boundary: This record establishes a reported Bolide missile delivery for Lithuania's RBS-70 system, a €7 million delivery value, Saab Dynamics as manufacturer, and a broader supply contract. It does not establish quantity, acceptance, training, firing readiness, operational use, replenishment, interception, deterrence, civilian protection, or public legitimacy.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: The hash covers the compact project follow-up memo derived from the Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence source; contract files, inventory records, training logs, and operational-use data are not retained.
